description_en: Performs a paging query of cloud browser groups and their current statuses
description_zh: 分页查询云浏览器组及其当前状态
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center list-browser-instance-group --page-size 20 --page-number 1 --status PUBLISHED --browser-instance-group-id 'big-0c7loey7fzjq****' --app-instance-group-set-id set-3jm9d0abc00example --cloud-browser-name '办公' --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --tag '[{"Value":"-","Key":"-"}]' --browser-instance-group-name '办公' --user-group-ids ug-12345 --excluded-user-group-ids ug-12345 --office-site-id 'cn-hangzhou+dir-843734****' --tier Pro --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListBrowserInstanceGroup

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 查询页码，从第 1 页开始
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
Filters cloud browser groups by status.

Limit: You can specify only one status at a time
parameters.help_zh:
按浏览器组状态筛选。

限制： 一次只能传入一个状态
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud browser group. This parameter is used for exact match
parameters.help_zh: 云浏览器组标识，用于精确查询
parameters.name: browser_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the browser group set. This parameter is used to query the valid members of the set by exact match
parameters.help_zh: 浏览器组集合标识，用于精确查询该集合的有效成员
parameters.name: app_instance_group_set_id

parameters.help_en: Filters cloud browser groups by name or ID based on partial match
parameters.help_zh: 按浏览器组名称或标识进行包含匹配
parameters.name: cloud_browser_name

parameters.help_en: Filters cloud browser groups by business region
parameters.help_zh: 按业务地域筛选浏览器组
parameters.name: biz_region_id

fields.help_en: The tag key. Do not specify this parameter in customer-facing scenarios
fields.help_zh: 标签键。当前对客场景不填写
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. Do not specify this parameter in customer-facing scenarios
fields.help_zh: 标签值。当前对客场景不填写
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tag filtering parameter. This parameter is not supported in customer-facing scenarios. Do not specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 标签筛选参数。当前对客场景暂不支持，请勿填写
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The name of the browser group. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 浏览器组名称，支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: browser_instance_group_name

parameters.help_en: Filters cloud browser groups by the IDs of authorized user groups
parameters.help_zh: 按已授权的用户组标识筛选
parameters.name: user_group_ids

parameters.help_en: Excludes cloud browser groups that are authorized to the specified user groups
parameters.help_zh: 排除已授权给指定用户组的浏览器组
parameters.name: excluded_user_group_ids

parameters.help_en: Filters cloud browser groups by the ID of the office network to which they belong
parameters.help_zh: 按所属办公网络标识筛选浏览器组
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en:
Filters cloud browser groups by browser version. Valid values:

`Basic`: Basic Edition.
`Pro`: Premium Edition.

Use `Pro` when you query MAU browser groups
parameters.help_zh:
按浏览器版本筛选。

`Basic`：基础版。
`Pro`：高级版。

查询 MAU 浏览器组时使用 `Pro`
parameters.name: tier

BrowserInstanceGroupModels.description_en: The list of browser instance groups on the current page
BrowserInstanceGroupModels.description_zh: 当前页的浏览器组列表

AuthNotificationEnabled.description_en: Specifies whether notification emails for authorization and revocation are enabled. A value of `true` indicates that the feature is enabled. A value of `false` indicates that the feature is disabled
AuthNotificationEnabled.description_zh: 是否启用授权及解除授权通知邮件。`true` 表示启用，`false` 表示关闭
AuthNotificationEnabled.title_en: 是否启用授权及解除授权通知邮件
AuthNotificationEnabled.title_zh: 是否启用授权及解除授权通知邮件

AuthorizedUserInfo.description_en: The statistics of authorized users for the browser instance group
AuthorizedUserInfo.description_zh: 浏览器组的授权用户统计

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of authorized users

TotalUserGroupCount.description_en: The total number of authorized user groups

BizRegionId.description_en: The business region where the browser instance group is located
BizRegionId.description_zh: 浏览器组所在的业务地域

BrowserConfig.description_en: The current configuration of the browser

BrowserParam.description_en: The browser startup parameters. For example, `--incognito` specifies an incognito window
BrowserParam.description_zh: 浏览器启动参数，例如 `--incognito` 表示隐身窗口

CookiesSync.description_en: The cookie synchronization configuration. A value of `true` indicates that synchronization is enabled. A value of `false` indicates that synchronization is disabled
CookiesSync.description_zh: Cookie 同步配置。字符串 `true` 表示开启，`false` 表示关闭

Homepage.description_en: The homepage URL that opens when the browser starts
Homepage.description_zh: 浏览器启动时打开的首页地址

BrowserInstanceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the cloud browser instance group

BrowserInstanceGroupName.description_en: The name of the cloud browser instance group

BrowserInstanceGroupSetId.description_en: The ID of the browser instance group set to which the group belongs
BrowserInstanceGroupSetId.description_zh: 所属浏览器组集合的标识
BrowserInstanceGroupSetId.title_en: 浏览器交付组集合 ID。
BrowserInstanceGroupSetId.title_zh: 浏览器交付组集合 ID。

ChargeType.description_en: The billing method. In the MAU scenario, `PostPaid` is returned, which indicates pay-as-you-go
ChargeType.description_zh: 付费类型。MAU 场景返回 `PostPaid`，表示后付费

DefaultAccessUrl.description_en: The default access URL of the browser instance group. Use the actual URL returned by the API operation. Replace the resource ID in the example
DefaultAccessUrl.description_zh: 浏览器组的默认访问地址。请使用接口实际返回的地址访问；示例中的资源标识需要替换

Duration.description_en: The package duration information. This parameter is not applicable to the MAU scenario and may return an empty object
Duration.description_zh: 套餐时长信息。MAU 场景不涉及套餐时长，可返回空对象

CurrentPayStage.description_en: The current payment stage of the package. This parameter is not applicable to the MAU scenario
CurrentPayStage.description_zh: 套餐当前支付阶段。MAU 场景不涉及

PeriodEndTime.description_en: The end time of the package cycle. This parameter is not applicable to the MAU scenario and is not returned
PeriodEndTime.description_zh: 套餐周期结束时间。MAU 场景不涉及，不返回该字段

PeriodStartTime.description_en: The start time of the package cycle. This parameter is not applicable to the MAU scenario and is not returned
PeriodStartTime.description_zh: 套餐周期开始时间。MAU 场景不涉及，不返回该字段

TotalDuration.description_en: The total duration of the package, in seconds. This parameter is not applicable to the MAU scenario
TotalDuration.description_zh: 套餐总时长，单位为秒。MAU 场景不涉及

UsedDuration.description_en: The used duration of the package, in seconds. This parameter is not applicable to the MAU scenario
UsedDuration.description_zh: 套餐已使用时长，单位为秒。MAU 场景不涉及

ExpiredTime.description_en: The expiration time of the browser instance group. This parameter is not applicable to the MAU scenario and is not returned
ExpiredTime.description_zh: 浏览器组过期时间。MAU 场景不涉及，不返回该字段

GmtCreate.description_en: The creation time of the browser instance group. The time follows the RFC 3339 standard in the `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSXXX` format, which includes milliseconds and time zone offset. The actual POP response uses the UTC offset `+00:00`
GmtCreate.description_zh:
浏览器组创建时间。

使用 RFC 3339 格式，具体为 `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSXXX`，包含毫秒和时区偏移；实际 POP 返回使用 UTC 偏移 `+00:00`

Homepage.description_en: The homepage URL of the browser instance group

ImageId.description_en: The ID of the image used by the browser instance group
ImageId.description_zh: 浏览器组使用的镜像标识

InstanceType.description_en: The instance type used by the browser instance group
InstanceType.description_zh: 浏览器组使用的实例规格

Network.description_en: The office network and website access restriction configurations
Network.description_zh: 办公网络及网站访问限制配置

AccessRestriction.description_en:
The website access restriction mode. Valid values:

`ALLOW_ALL`: Allows all domain names.
`ALLOW_LIST`: Allows only websites in the whitelist.

The returned value reflects the existing configuration of the browser instance group
AccessRestriction.description_zh:
网站访问限制模式。

`ALLOW_ALL`：允许所有域名。
`ALLOW_LIST`：仅允许名单内的网站。

返回值反映该浏览器组现有配置

OfficeSiteId.description_en: The ID of the office network to which the browser instance group belongs
OfficeSiteId.description_zh: 浏览器组所属的办公网络标识

VSwitchIds.description_en: The list of vSwitch IDs used by the browser instance group. This parameter is available for scenarios where a custom network is configured
VSwitchIds.description_zh: 浏览器组使用的交换机标识列表，供已配置定制网络的场景查看

OsType.description_en: The operating system type of the browser instance group. The current MAU product scenario uses Windows
OsType.description_zh: 浏览器组的操作系统类型。当前 MAU 产品场景使用 Windows

Policy.description_en: The policy configuration returned for the browser instance group. The policy fields are used to view existing settings and do not indicate that all corresponding creation parameters are configurable
Policy.description_zh: 浏览器组返回的策略配置。策略字段用于查看现有设置，不代表对应创建参数均可配置

AppContentProtection.description_en:
The screen capture prevention switch. Valid values:

`on`: Enables screen capture prevention.
`off`: Disables screen capture prevention
AppContentProtection.description_zh:
防截屏开关。

`on`：开启防截屏。
`off`：关闭防截屏

AuthorizeAccessPolicyRules.description_en: The IP address whitelist rules for client access
AuthorizeAccessPolicyRules.description_zh: 客户端访问 IP 白名单规则

items.description_en: A configuration item in the list

CidrIp.description_en: The source CIDR block of the client that is allowed to access
CidrIp.description_zh: 允许访问的客户端来源网段

Description.description_en: The description of the client access rule
Description.description_zh: 客户端访问规则的说明

Policy.description_en:
The action of the client access rule. Valid values:

`allow`: Allows access.
`deny`: Denies access
Policy.description_zh:
客户端访问规则的动作。

`allow`：允许访问。
`deny`：拒绝访问

ClientTypes.description_en: The list of client access control configurations
ClientTypes.description_zh: 客户端访问控制配置列表

items.description_en: A configuration item in the list

ClientType.description_en:
The client type. Valid values:

`windows`: Windows client.
`macos`: macOS client.
`html5`: Web client.
`linux`: Linux client.
`android`: Android client.
`ios`: iOS client.

This field reflects the existing access configurations and does not indicate that all clients are currently available for the product
ClientType.description_zh:
客户端类型。

`windows`：Windows 客户端。
`macos`：macOS 客户端。
`html5`：Web 客户端。
`linux`：Linux 客户端。
`android`：Android 客户端。
`ios`：iOS 客户端。

本字段反映已有访问配置，不代表当前产品开放所有客户端

Status.description_en:
The access policy switch for the client type. Valid values:

`on`: Allows access from this type of client.
`off`: Denies access from this type of client
Status.description_zh:
该客户端类型的访问策略开关。

`on`：允许该类客户端访问。
`off`：禁止该类客户端访问

ClipboardPolicy.description_en: Sets the clipboard transfer direction, content type, and size limit. `read` indicates transfer from the local PC to the cloud browser, and `write` indicates transfer from the cloud browser to the local PC
ClipboardPolicy.description_zh: 设置剪贴板传输方向、内容类型和大小限制。read 表示本地 PC 到云浏览器，write 表示云浏览器到本地 PC

Clipboard.description_en:
The clipboard transfer direction. The value is not case-sensitive. Valid values:

`off`: Prohibits transfer in both directions.
`read`: Allows copy and paste from the local PC to the cloud browser.
`write`: Allows copy and paste from the cloud browser to the local PC.
`readwrite`: Allows transfer in both directions
Clipboard.description_zh:
剪贴板传输方向，取值不区分大小写。

`off`：双向禁止。
`read`：允许本地 PC 向云浏览器复制粘贴。
`write`：允许云浏览器向本地 PC 复制粘贴。
`readwrite`：双向允许

MultiScreen.description_en: The dual-screen switch for the cloud browser

VideoPolicy.description_en: The video display policy for browser sessions
VideoPolicy.description_zh: 浏览器会话的视频显示策略

FrameRate.description_en: The frame rate for browser sessions
FrameRate.description_zh: 浏览器会话的画面帧率

WatermarkPolicy.description_en: The watermark display configuration for browser sessions
WatermarkPolicy.description_zh: 浏览器会话的水印显示配置

WatermarkSwitch.description_en:
The watermark switch. The value is case-insensitive. Valid values:

`ON`: Enables the watermark.
`OFF`: Disables the watermark.

If the watermark is disabled, the watermark content type list is not used
WatermarkSwitch.description_zh:
水印开关，取值不区分大小写。

`ON`：开启水印。
`OFF`：关闭水印。

关闭时不使用水印内容类型列表

WatermarkTypes.description_en:
The list of watermark content types. Valid values:

`EndUserId`: The user identifier.
`InstanceGroupId`: The delivery group identifier.
`ClientTime`: The current time of the client.

Use the watermark types supported by the browser and the client
WatermarkTypes.description_zh:
水印内容类型列表。

`EndUserId`：用户标识。
`InstanceGroupId`：交付组标识。
`ClientTime`：客户端当前时间。

请使用浏览器及客户端支持的水印类型

items.description_en: The watermark content type. `EndUserId` indicates the user identifier, `InstanceGroupId` indicates the delivery group identifier, and `ClientTime` indicates the current time of the client
items.description_zh: 水印内容类型。EndUserId 表示用户标识，InstanceGroupId 表示交付组标识，ClientTime 表示客户端当前时间

Status.description_en:
The status of the browser group. Valid values:

`DEPLOYING`: Deploying.
`PUBLISHED`: Published.
`FAILED`: Failed.
`EXPIRED`: Expired.
`CEASED`: Suspended due to overdue payment.
`MAINTAINING`: Updating.
`MAINTAIN_FAILED`: Update failed.
`DELETING`: Deleting.
`UNAVAILABLE`: Unavailable
Status.description_zh:
浏览器组状态。

`DEPLOYING`：发布中。
`PUBLISHED`：发布成功。
`FAILED`：发布失败。
`EXPIRED`：已过期。
`CEASED`：欠费停服。
`MAINTAINING`：更新中。
`MAINTAIN_FAILED`：更新失败。
`DELETING`：删除中。
`UNAVAILABLE`：不可用

SubPayType.description_en: The sub-billing method. In the MAU scenario, `mau` is returned, which indicates billing by monthly active users
SubPayType.description_zh: 付费子类型。MAU 场景实际返回 `mau`，表示按月活跃用户计费

SupportUserGroupMixedAuth.description_en: Indicates whether mixed authorization of users and user groups is supported. A value of `true` indicates that it is supported, and a value of `false` indicates that it is not supported. Evaluate this parameter based on the current authorization mode
SupportUserGroupMixedAuth.description_zh: 是否支持用户和用户组混合授权。`true` 表示支持，`false` 表示不支持；应结合当前授权模式判断
SupportUserGroupMixedAuth.title_en: 是否支持用户和用户组混合授权。
SupportUserGroupMixedAuth.title_zh: 是否支持用户和用户组混合授权。

Tags.description_en: The list of resource tags returned

Tier.description_en:
The version of the browser. Valid values:

`Basic`: Basic Edition.
`Pro`: Premium Edition.

In the MAU scenario, the value is `Pro`
Tier.description_zh:
浏览器版本。

`Basic`：基础版。
`Pro`：高级版。

MAU 场景为 `Pro`

Timers.description_en: The session timer configuration returned. This is used to view the effective settings and does not indicate that the create operation supports configuring this parameter
Timers.description_zh: 当前返回的会话定时配置，用于查看生效设置，不表示创建接口支持设置该参数

items.description_en: A configuration item in the list

Interval.description_en: The session retention duration after disconnection, in minutes. A value of `-1` indicates that the session is not unbound due to the timeout of this duration, but is still affected by authorization and other session release policies
Interval.description_zh: 断开连接后的会话保留时长，单位为分钟。`-1` 表示不因该时长超时解绑，仍受授权和其他会话释放策略影响

TimerType.description_en: The timer configuration type. A value of `SESSION_TIMEOUT` indicates the session retention duration after disconnection
TimerType.description_zh: 定时配置类型。`SESSION_TIMEOUT` 表示断开连接后的会话保留时长

UserGroupAuthMode.description_en:
The current authorization mode. Valid values:

`Mixed`: Mixed authorization of users and user groups.
`User`: User authorization.
`UserGroup`: User group authorization
UserGroupAuthMode.description_zh:
当前授权模式。

`Mixed`：用户和用户组混合授权。
`User`：用户授权。
`UserGroup`：用户组授权
UserGroupAuthMode.title_en: 用户和用户组授权模式。
UserGroupAuthMode.title_zh: 用户和用户组授权模式。

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的标识，用于排查问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of browser groups that meet the filter conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合筛选条件的浏览器组总数
